title: Truncate Long Context
statement: Read an integer max_len, then a context string. If the context is longer than max_len characters, print only the first max_len characters followed by '...'. Otherwise print it unchanged.
starter_code:
max_len = int(input())
context = input()
# TODO: print the (possibly truncated) context
hints: Compare len(context) to max_len before deciding whether to slice and append '...'

test_cases.stdin:
10
This is a very long piece of context text
